title: Direct Tailscale checks and Android build preparation
summary: App and viewer checks pass. Android server tests found a test-client Origin-header issue; corrected test rerun and APK build are pending.

changes.detail: Prepare Android 1.0.10 build 12 with a separate native runtime version, localized sharing states and disabled unavailable actions.
Browser interaction and real local HTTP server tests cover consent, authentication, lock-screen frame withholding, expiry and invalid attempts.
Cancel pending capture requests on Stop; handle VPN interface lookup failures; restrict detection to VPN interfaces. Replaced a test client that silently stripped Origin with raw HTTP requests.

validation.name: Change history
validation.detail: Six history tests passed and 138 reports validated before this append.

validation.name: Android compilation
validation.detail: ARM64 compileDebugKotlin completed successfully; latest native and unit test sources subsequently compiled.

validation.name: Android protocol tests
validation.detail: Initial run: 3 passed, foreign-Origin assertion failed because HttpURLConnection omitted the Origin header. Test now uses raw sockets; rerun pending.

validation.name: Physical devices and release APK
validation.detail: Awaiting device connection and APK generation. Initial prebuild hit a locked generated file; restored generated template files and completed prebuild with --no-clean. Initial unrestricted ABI build failed on existing Python dependency; ARM64 compilation passed.
